systemic_trigger.entry_at_close: wc_dd<=-10% AND green<=25% AND SPY_r20<=-1% AND recent_leadership_r20<0 AND recent_leadership_r40<=-3%
systemic_trigger.rearm: 7 consecutive recent_r20>0 AND recent_r40>0 sessions OR SPY_r20>+11%

funding_contract.source: Stage4 exact natural Wealth Core cash telemetry
funding_contract.allowed: active Wealth Core sleeve next-open unreserved cash after preserving pending Wealth Core admission
funding_contract.hedge_budget_cap: minimum of prior-close next-open-unreserved estimate and actual cash remaining after Wealth Core next-open fills
funding_contract.rolls_may_use: unused original hedge budget plus hedge proceeds

observed_stage7_gate.history_boundary: Alpaca historical option data available from February 2024 onward
observed_stage7_gate.contract_selection: for each modeled leg use the real put with expiration closest to the preregistered target DTE and strike closest to the preregistered strike ratio, determined without using subsequent option returns
observed_stage7_gate.observed_price_source: Alpaca historical option daily bars for the selected real contracts
observed_stage7_gate.coverage_requirement: observed bars must cover at least 80% of modeled entry premium notional in each required target episode
observed_stage7_gate.entry_cost_check: observed first-trade daily-bar entry premium may be at most 15% above the conservative modeled executable entry premium for each required target episode in aggregate
observed_stage7_gate.exit_value_check: observed first-trade daily-bar exit proceeds may be at most 15% below conservative modeled executable exit proceeds for each required target episode in aggregate
observed_stage7_gate.feed_evidence: record the Alpaca entitlement/feed actually returned; indicative data remains lower-grade evidence than OPRA and is labeled explicitly
observed_stage7_gate.purpose: test whether modeled executable premiums and hedge proceeds are materially optimistic relative to observed option data

e8_open_rule: E8 may be spent only after the modeled Stage6 gate and observed Stage7 gate both pass. Otherwise experiment budget remains 7/10.
